{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Tomb of Lord Red Mask
| Image = Event-RedMaskTomb.png
}} {{Small Relic Infobox|Red Mask}}
{{E|Tomb of Lord Red Mask}} is an [[Event]] found in [[Act 3]].

== Options ==
=== If The Player Owns {{R|Red Mask}} ===
{{Frame|Don the Red Mask}} {{TS|positive||Gain 222 [[Gold]].}}
* The player gets to keep {{R|Red Mask}} afterwards. The [[Gold]] is purely a reward for owning the relic.

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. 
<br>
<br>

=== If The Player Does Not Own {{R|Red Mask}} ===
{{Frame|Locked}} Requires: {{R|Red Mask}}
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Offer: X Gold}} {{TS|negative||Lose all [[Gold]].}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* X is equal to all of the player's [[Gold]].
* Rewards the player with {{R|Red Mask}}.

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. 

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
A highly ornamented tomb can be seen on the other side of a floating path. Upon reaching the tomb, you notice a slot for {{TS|gold||gold}} coins with a scratched out inscription above it.
</div> 

{{Frame|Don the Red Mask}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You don the mask and the tomb starts to {{TS||up|flake away...}} a secret passage!<br>
<br>
The passage is lined with countless stolen goods and mounds of {{TS|gold||gold!}}
</div> </blockquote>

{{Frame|Offer: X Gold}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
An opening appears in the tomb and out slides a small red mask with a note attached. "Take from others as I have taken from you!"
</div> </blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote>
(No dialogue)
</blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* {{R|Red Mask}} is obtained from the [[Act 2]] event {{E|Masked Bandits}}.
